notes.title: Want a playtest?
notes.content: [p]For years, we wondered how to make our [i]dream game[/i]— where you build a neon-drenched city and bring it to life piece-by-piece, from the first person perspective.[/p][p]It wasn’t until the rise of automation and base building games like [i]Subnautica[/i], [i]Planet Crafter[/i], and [i]Satisfactory[/i] that we realized how we could make it possible: with deep crafting loops and unleashing player expression.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691625/021ce1afb2cf732441226a92e34b066377dfc691.png"][/img][/p][p]Do you want to playtest [i]Cyberpunk Crafter [/i]before it's demo release? You’ll be able to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Build and own venues[/b] ranging from ramen stalls and junk shops to VR clubs and cybernetic clinics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stock shelves and run services[/b] that attract different citizens and keep them satisfied.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Help citizens move in[/b]—Gutterpunks crashing in sleep pods, Wireborn shaping realspace from cyberspace, and many more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Earn ingredients from your venues[/b] to fuel deeper crafting and automation loops.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlock research with idle stat bonuses[/b] earning blueprints passively from venues you operate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grow your city’s population[/b] and balance citizen satisfaction to unlock greater features.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Automate your economy[/b] by linking venues, needs, and workers together into a living system.[/p][/*][/list][p]Over the next few weeks, we’ll share more about how these systems tie together and why we think fans of survival-crafting and automation games will love it.[/p][p]We'll share a few posts diving into progression and crafting loops, and see if there's enough interest for a play test, which would be available for sign-up right here on Steam in the near future.[/p][p]Be sure to add us to your [b]Wishlist [/b]and hit[b] Follow[/b]. Great things are coming.[/p][p][/p][p]Our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3813070/discussions/"]community page[/url] and [url="https://discord.gg/Bd7AvPCzHJ"]Discord i[/url]s the best place to let us know and step in line with our fledgling community, we look forward to chatting with you![/p]
